Vipākattika (The Triplet on Resultant States)
Section on Analysis:
Root Condition.
Dependent upon a resultant state, a resultant state arises by way of root condition: dependent upon one resultant aggregate...

Dependent on [one] aggregate, [arise] three aggregates … dependent on two aggregates, [arise] two aggregates. At the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on one resultant aggregate, [arise] three aggregates … dependent on two aggregates, [arise] two aggregates.
Dependent on a resultant state, a state that is neither-resultant-nor-possessing-the-nature-of-result arises by way of root condition: dependent on resultant [states] …

Dependent on aggregates, mind-originated matter arises; at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on resultant aggregates, kamma-produced matter arises, and dependent on aggregates, the [heart-]base arises.
Dependent on a resultant state, both resultant states and states that are neither-resultant-nor-of-the-nature-of-result arise.
Conditioned by root: dependent on one resultant aggregate, there arise three aggregates and mind-produced matter … dependent on two aggregates, there arise two aggregates and mind-produced matter;

at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on one resultant aggregate, there arise three aggregates and kamma-produced matter … dependent on two aggregates, [there arise two aggregates and kamma-produced matter].
The aggregates and the matter produced by kamma.

Dependent on a state subject to result, a state subject to result arises by way of root condition: dependent on one aggregate subject to result, three aggregates [arise] … dependent on two aggregates, two aggregates [arise].

Dependent on a state subject to result, a state that is neither result nor subject to result arises by way of root condition: dependent on the aggregates subject to result, mind-originated matter [arises].

Dependent on a state that is subject to ripening (*vipākadhammadhamma*), there arise states that are both subject to ripening and neither-ripening-nor-subject-to-ripening by way of the root condition (*hetupaccaya*):
dependent on one aggregate subject to ripening, there arise three aggregates and mind-produced matter;
... dependent on two aggregates, there arise two aggregates and mind-produced matter.
Dependent on a state that is neither resultant nor of a nature to produce resultants, there arises a state that is neither resultant nor of a nature to produce resultants by way of root condition:

dependent on one aggregate that is neither resultant nor of a nature to produce resultants, there arise three aggregates and mind-produced matter … dependent on two aggregates, there arise two aggregates and mind-produced matter; [dependent on] one great primary element … [and so forth].
Dependent on [one] great primary element, [arise] three great primary elements … dependent on two great primary elements, [arise] two great primary elements;
dependent on the great primary elements, arise mind-produced matter, kamma-produced matter, and derived matter.

Dependent on a state that is neither resultant nor of a nature to produce resultants, a resultant state arises by way of root condition: at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on the [heart-]base, the resultant aggregates arise.

Dependent on a state that is neither resultant nor of a nature to produce resultants, there arise states that are both resultant and neither resultant nor of a nature to produce resultants, by way of root condition:
at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on the [heart-]base, resultant aggregates arise;
dependent on the great elements, kamma-produced matter arises.
Dependent on a resultant phenomenon and a phenomenon that is neither-resultant-nor-of-the-nature-to-arise-as-a-resultant, a resultant phenomenon arises by way of root condition:
at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on one resultant aggregate and the [heart-]base,
three aggregates arise …pe… dependent on two aggregates and the [heart-]base, two aggregates arise.

Dependent on a resultant state and a state that is neither-resultant-nor-of-the-nature-of-resultant, there arises a state that is neither-resultant-nor-of-the-nature-of-resultant by way of root condition:
dependent on resultant aggregates and the great primaries, mind-produced matter arises;
at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on resultant aggregates and the great primaries, kamma-wrought matter arises.

Dependent on a resultant state and a state that is neither-resultant-nor-of-the-nature-to-arise-as-a-resultant, there arise resultant states and states that are neither-resultant-nor-of-the-nature-to-arise-as-a-resultant by way of root condition:

at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on one resultant aggregate and the [heart-]base, three aggregates arise … pe … dependent on two aggregates and the [heart-]base, two aggregates arise; [likewise] dependent on resultant aggregates … pe … [dependent on resultant aggregates and the heart-base, resultant consciousness arises].
And dependent on great primary elements, kamma-produced matter arises.
Dependent on a state that is subject to result and a state that is neither-result-nor-cause-of-result, a state that is neither-result-nor-cause-of-result arises by way of root condition:
dependent on aggregates that are subject to result and great primary elements, mind-originated matter arises.
Dependent on a resultant state as object-condition, a resultant state arises by way of object-condition: dependent on one resultant aggregate, three aggregates arise ...
[and so on] ... dependent on two aggregates, two aggregates arise; at the moment of rebirth-linking, resultant ...
Dependent on one aggregate, three aggregates arise … dependent on two aggregates, two aggregates arise.

Dependent on a state that is of the nature to produce result (vipākadhammadhamma), a state that is of the nature to produce result arises by way of object condition: dependent on one aggregate that is of the nature to produce result, three aggregates arise … dependent on two aggregates, two aggregates arise.

Dependent on a state that is neither result nor of the nature to produce result (nevavipākanavipākadhammadhamma), a state that is neither result nor of the nature to produce result arises … [and so forth].
By way of object condition: dependent on one aggregate that is neither-result-nor-dhamma-of-the-result-type, there arise three aggregates … dependent on two aggregates, there arise two aggregates.

Dependent on a dhamma that is neither-result-nor-dhamma-of-the-result-type, a resultant dhamma arises by way of object condition: at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on the [heart-]base, the resultant aggregates arise.
Dependent on a resultant state and a state that is neither-resultant-nor-of-the-nature-to-arise-as-a-resultant, a resultant state arises by way of object condition:
at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on one resultant aggregate and the [heart-]base,
three aggregates arise …pe… dependent on two aggregates and the base, two aggregates arise.

Dependent on a resultant state, a resultant state arises by way of predominance condition: dependent on one resultant aggregate, three aggregates arise … dependent on two aggregates, two aggregates arise.
Dependent on a resultant state, a state that is neither-resultant-nor-producer-of-result arises by way of predominance condition: dependent on resultant aggregates, mind-produced matter arises.
Dependent on a resultant state, both resultant and neither-resultant-nor-non-resultant states arise by way of predominance condition:
dependent on one resultant aggregate, three aggregates and mind-produced matter arise … dependent on two aggregates, two aggregates and mind-produced matter arise.
Dependent on a state that is of the nature to ripen, three [states arise].
Dependent on a state that is neither-result-nor-of-the-nature-to-ripen, a state that is neither-result-nor-of-the-nature-to-ripen arises by way of the predominance condition:
dependent on one aggregate that is neither-result-nor-of-the-nature-to-ripen, three aggregates [arise].
And mind-originated matter … depending on two aggregates, there arise two aggregates and mind-originated matter;
depending on one great primary element, there arise three great primary elements … depending on the great primary elements, there arise mind-originated matter and derived matter.

Dependent on a state that is both resultant and neither-resultant-nor-producing-resultant, there arises a state that is neither-resultant-nor-producing-resultant by way of predominance condition: dependent on resultant aggregates and great primary elements, there arises mind-originated matter.

Dependent on a state that is subject to ripening (*vipākadhammadhamma*) and a state that is neither ripening nor subject to ripening (*nevavipākanavipākadhammadhamma*), there arises a state that is neither ripening nor subject to ripening by way of the predominance condition (*adhipatipaccaya*):

dependent on aggregates subject to ripening and the great primary elements (*mahābhūta*), mind-originated matter (*cittasamuṭṭhāna-rūpa*) arises. [The same applies to] the immediate and subsequent conditions (*anantarādi*).

Dependent on a resultant state, a resultant state arises by way of proximity-condition … by way of contiguity-condition … (as in the object-condition) … by way of co-nascence-condition. (The entirety of the co-nascence [section] is the same as the root-cause-condition.

Dependent on a state that is neither-resultant-nor-producing-a-resultant-state, a state that is neither-resultant-nor-producing-a-resultant-state arises by way of co-nascence-condition … pe … external … nutriment-originated … temperature-originated … in the case of non-percipient beings.
(In this case of co-arising, this is the distinction. Regarding mutual conditionality:
dependent on a resultant state, a resultant state arises by way of mutual condition—dependent on one resultant aggregate...

Dependent on one resultant aggregate, three aggregates arise … dependent on two aggregates, two aggregates arise. At the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on one resultant aggregate, three aggregates arise … dependent on two aggregates, two aggregates arise.

Dependent on a resultant state, a state that is neither-resultant-nor-producing-result arises by way of mutuality condition: at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on the resultant aggregates, the [heart-]base arises.
Dependent on a resultant state, both resultant and neither-resultant-nor-producing-resultant states arise by way of mutuality condition:
at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on one resultant aggregate,
the three aggregates and the [heart-]base arise …pe… dependent on two aggregates, the two aggregates and the [heart-]base arise.

Dependent on a state subject to ripening, a state subject to ripening arises by way of mutuality condition: dependent on one aggregate subject to ripening, three aggregates [arise] …pe… dependent on two aggregates, two aggregates [arise].

Dependent on a state that is neither ripening nor subject to ripening, a state that is neither ripening nor subject to ripening arises by way of mutuality condition: dependent on one aggregate that is neither ripening nor subject to ripening, three aggregates [arise].
... pe ... one great primary element ... pe ... external ... nutriment-produced ... temperature-produced ... one great primary element of non-percipient beings ... pe ...

Dependent on a state that is neither resultant nor productive of result, a resultant state arises by way of mutuality condition: at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on the [heart-]base, the resultant aggregates arise.
Dependent on a resultant state and a state that is neither-resultant-nor-of-the-nature-of-resultant, a resultant state arises by way of mutuality condition:
at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on one resultant aggregate and the [heart-]base,
three aggregates arise … pe … dependent on two aggregates and the [heart-]base, two aggregates arise.

Dependent on a resultant state, a resultant state arises by way of dependence condition (*nissaya-paccaya*)— abbreviated— as well as by way of strong-dependence condition (*upanissaya-paccaya*) and prenascence condition (*purejāta-paccaya*).
Repetition...

Dependent on a state subject to ripening, a state subject to ripening arises by way of the condition of repetition: dependent on one aggregate subject to ripening, three aggregates [arise] … dependent on two aggregates, two aggregates [arise].
Dependent on a state that is neither ripening nor subject to ripening, a state that is neither ripening nor subject to ripening arises by way of the condition of repetition:
dependent on one aggregate that is neither ripening nor subject to ripening, three aggregates [arise].
...pe... dependent on two aggregates, two aggregates [arise].
Dependent on a resultant state, a resultant state arises by way of kamma-condition (*kammapaccaya*) (abbreviated)... by way of resultant-condition (*vipākapaccaya*) ... three.
Dependent on a state that is neither-resultant-nor-of-the-nature-of-result, a state that is neither-resultant-nor-of-the-nature-of-result arises by way of resultant condition:
dependent on one great primary, three great primaries [arise] …pe… dependent on the great primaries,
mind-produced matter, kamma-produced matter, and derived matter [arise].

Dependent on a state that is neither resultant nor of a nature to produce resultants, a resultant state arises by way of resultant condition: at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on the [heart-]base, the resultant aggregates arise.

Dependent on a state that is neither resultant nor of a nature to produce resultants, both resultant and states that are neither resultant nor of a nature to produce resultants arise by way of resultant condition:
at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on the [heart-]base, the resultant aggregates arise.
Dependent on great primary elements, kamma-produced matter arises.

Dependent on a state that is both resultant and a state that is neither-resultant-nor-causing-a-resultant, a resultant state arises by way of resultant condition …pe… a state that is neither-resultant-nor-causing-a-resultant arises by way of resultant condition. Resultant [state] …pe… [end].
And neither-result-nor-non-result-dhammas arise as result-conditions … [as appropriate] … Nutriment, etc.:
dependent on a resultant dhamma, a resultant dhamma arises by way of nutriment-condition (abbreviated) … by way of faculty-condition.

… by way of the condition of jhāna … by way of the condition of the path … by way of the condition of association … by way of the condition of dissociation … by way of the condition of presence … by way of the condition of absence … by way of the condition of disappearance … by way of the condition of non-disappearance.
Chapter on Enumeration.
In the pure condition of cause there are thirteen; in object, five; in predominance, nine; in proximity, five; in contiguity, five;
in conascence, thirteen; in mutuality, seven; in dependence, thirteen; in strong-dependence, five; in prenascence, three.
In the case of repetition, there are two; in kamma, thirteen; in result, nine; in nutriment, thirteen; in faculty, thirteen;
in jhāna, thirteen; in path, thirteen; in association, five; in dissociation, thirteen; in presence, thirteen; in absence, five;
in disappearance, five; in non-disappearance, thirteen.
Hetuduka:
With the root condition as the causal relation, there are five [results] in the object condition … pe … thirteen in the non-disappearance condition … pe ….
It should be counted in the same manner as the enumeration for the wholesome triad (*kusalattika*).

Āsevana-dvika: By way of the condition of repetition (āsevanapaccaya), there are two [types] in relation to root (hetu), two in relation to object (ārammaṇa), two in relation to predominance (adhipati), two in relation to immediate (anantara), two in relation to contiguity (samanantara),

two in relation to co-nascence (sahajāta), two in relation to mutuality (aññamañña), two in relation to support (nissaya), two in relation to decisive support (upanissaya), two in relation to prenascence (purejāta), and two in relation to kamma (kamma).
Two, two nutriments, two faculties, two jhānas, two paths, two associations, two dissociations,
two presences, two absences, two disappearances, two non-disappearances …pe….
The Resultant Dyad.
With resultant condition as the reference: nine with root, three with object, five with predominance,
three with proximity, three with contiguity, nine with conascence, six with mutuality, nine with dependence, three with strong-dependence,
one with prenascence, nine with kamma, nine with nutriment, nine with faculty, nine with jhāna, nine with path, three with association, [three] with dissociation...
Nine [conditions] for presence; three for absence; three for disappearance; nine for non-disappearance. (Abbreviated.

Dependent on one aggregate, three aggregates arise … dependent on two aggregates, two aggregates arise;
at the moment of rootless rebirth-linking, dependent on one resultant aggregate, three aggregates arise; dependent on three aggregates, one aggregate arises;
dependent on two aggregates, two aggregates arise.
Dependent on resultant state, there arises a state that is neither-resultant-nor-of-the-nature-of-resultant by way of not-root condition:
dependent on rootless resultant aggregates, mind-produced matter arises; at the moment of rootless rebirth-linking, dependent on resultant aggregates, kamma-produced matter arises;
dependent on the aggregates, the [heart-]base arises.

Dependent on one resultant aggregate, three aggregates and kamma-produced matter arise … dependent on two aggregates, two aggregates and kamma-produced matter arise.

Dependent on a state subject to result, a state subject to result arises by way of not-root condition: dependent on doubt-accompanied or restlessness-accompanied aggregates, doubt-accompanied or restlessness-accompanied delusion arises.

Dependent on a state that is neither resultant nor of a nature to produce resultants, there arises a state that is neither resultant nor of a nature to produce resultants by way of the not-root condition:
dependent on one rootless aggregate that is neither resultant nor of a nature to produce resultants,
there arise three aggregates and mind-produced matter … dependent on two aggregates, there arise two aggregates and mind-produced matter.
Material form: dependent on one great primary element, three great primary elements arise … dependent on two great primary elements, two great primary elements arise;
dependent on the great primary elements, mind-produced matter, kamma-produced matter, and derived matter [arise].

External … nutriment-produced … temperature-produced … in the case of non-percipient beings, dependent on one great primary element, three great primary elements arise … [and so on] dependent on the great primary elements.
Dependent on derived matter, there is kamma-produced matter.

Dependent on a state that is neither resultant nor of a nature to produce resultants, a resultant state arises by way of the not-root condition: at the moment of rootless rebirth-linking, dependent on the [heart-]base, the resultant aggregates arise.
Dependent on a state that is neither resultant nor of a nature to produce resultants, both a resultant state and a state that is neither resultant nor of a nature to produce resultants [arise]...
And states arise without the root-condition: at the moment of rootless rebirth-linking, resultant aggregates arise dependent on the [heart-]base;
and kamma-produced matter arises dependent on the great primary elements.
Dependent on a state that is both resultant and a state that is neither-resultant-nor-a-state-having-the-nature-of-resultant, a resultant state arises.

Not by way of root condition: at the moment of rootless rebirth-linking, dependent on one resultant aggregate and the [heart-]base, [arise] three aggregates … dependent on two aggregates and the [heart-]base, [arise] two aggregates.
Dependent on a state that is both resultant and neither-resultant-nor-dhamma-of-the-resultant-type, [arises] a state that is neither-resultant-nor-dhamma-of-the-resultant-type.
[It] arises by way of non-root condition: dependent on rootless resultant aggregates and great primaries, mind-produced matter [arises];
at the moment of rootless rebirth-linking, dependent on resultant aggregates and great primaries, kamma-produced matter [arises].
Dependent on a state that is both resultant and neither-resultant-nor-non-resultant-dhamma, [there arises] a state that is resultant and neither-resultant-nor-non-resultant-dhamma...

And states arise without the root-cause condition: at the moment of rootless rebirth-linking, dependent on one resultant aggregate and the [heart-]base, three aggregates arise …pe… dependent on two aggregates and the [heart-]base, two aggregates arise;
and dependent on resultant aggregates and the great primaries, kamma-produced matter arises.
Dependent on a resultant state that is not an object-condition, there arises a state that is neither-resultant-nor-cause-of-resultant by way of object-condition:
dependent on resultant aggregates, mind-produced matter arises; at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on resultant aggregates, kamma-produced matter arises.
Dependent on aggregates, the [heart-]base arises.

Dependent on a state subject to result, a state that is neither-result-nor-subject-to-result arises by way of non-object condition: dependent on aggregates subject to result, mind-produced matter arises.
Dependent on a state that is neither-result-nor-subject-to-result, a state that is neither-result-nor-subject-to-result arises...

By way of object condition (*ārammaṇa-paccaya*): dependent on aggregates that are neither resultant nor of a nature to result (*nevavipāka-navipākadhamma-dhammā*), there arises mind-produced matter (*cittasamuṭṭhāna-rūpa*).

Dependent on one great primary (*mahābhūta*), there arise three great primaries … [and so on] … dependent on the great primaries, there arise mind-produced matter, kamma-born matter (*kaṭattā-rūpa*), and derived matter (*upādā-rūpa*).
External … nutriment-produced … temperature-produced … [matter of] non-percipient beings.
Dependent on one great primary element, three great primary elements [arise]; dependent on great primary elements, kamma-produced derived matter [arises].
Dependent on a state that is both resultant and neither-resultant-nor-producing-resultant, a state that is neither-resultant-nor-producing-resultant arises by way of non-object condition:
dependent on resultant aggregates and great primary elements, mind-originated [matter arises].
Materiality: at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on resultant aggregates and great primaries, there arises kamma-produced materiality.
Dependent on a state that is subject to result and a state that is neither-result-nor-subject-to-result, a state that is neither-result-nor-subject-to-result arises by way of non-object condition:
dependent on aggregates that are subject to result and the great primaries, mind-originated materiality arises.
